capacity.title: Execution capacity
capacity.description: A run takes capacity as a whole (concurrency × per-trial resources) and returns it only once the resources are confirmed released; runs whose cleanup failed keep holding it. Host totals come from the deployment configuration; here you only set how many trials each model provider may run at once.

masterKey.confirmRotate: Rotating the master key creates a new generation and re-encrypts all credentials. Make sure a working backup plan is in place first. Continue?
masterKey.title: Master key
masterKey.description: The master key is stored outside the database and cannot be deleted; only its status is shown here.

recycleBin.title: Recycle bin
recycleBin.description: Deleted objects land here first and can be restored; "Permanently delete" removes the content and files for good, cannot be undone, and keeps only a deletion receipt. The master key cannot be deleted.
